name: 18066 · New Tripoli, PA
findings: ZIP 18066 (New Tripoli) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 18066 (New Tripoli) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 18066 (New Tripoli) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.
